description: Header file defining the HpackEntryCollector class, which implements the HpackEntryDecoderListener interface for testing HPACK header decoding in HTTP/2. It records callback calls during header decoding for verification in tests.

classes.name: HpackEntryCollector
classes.description: A test utility class that records HPACK header entry decoding callbacks for verification in tests.

methods.name: HpackEntryCollector
methods.description: Constructs with specific header type and index or value.

methods.name: OnStartLiteralHeader
methods.description: Records start of a literal header.

methods.name: OnNameStart
methods.description: Records start of header name data.

methods.name: OnValueStart
methods.description: Records start of header value data.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the collector to be ready for a new entry.

methods.name: IsClear
methods.description: Checks if collector is reset and ready.

methods.name: IsComplete
methods.description: Checks if a complete header entry has been collected.

methods.name: LiteralNameExpected
methods.description: Determines if a literal name is expected based on header type.

methods.name: LiteralValueExpected
methods.description: Determines if a literal value is expected based on header type.

methods.name: ValidateIndexedHeader
methods.description: Verifies collected header matches expected index.

methods.name: ValidateLiteralValueHeader
methods.description: Verifies collected header with literal name and value.

methods.name: ValidateLiteralNameValueHeader
methods.description: Verifies collected header with literal name and value.

methods.name: AppendToHpackBlockBuilder
methods.description: Appends the collected header to a block builder.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the collector with header type and index.
